payload.title: mav's comment quotes a narrower architect arrow
payload.body: At e53e7200, packages/canon/src/agents/mav.ts opens its position paragraph with 'The role contract is reads⟨intent · C⟩ → writes⟨C⟩', while the architect role reads the intent, the design, notes, verdicts, broke-the-whole and ready names and writes the design, notes and routes. The sentences after it state the corrected position, so only the quoted arrow is stale. It is a comment and does not reach the projected agent.
